alternatives.name: Lazy evaluation via descriptors or thunks
alternatives.description: Instead of stringifying annotations, evaluate them lazily on first access using a descriptor protocol or thunk mechanism.
alternatives.reason_rejected: Considered too complex for the initial implementation. The stringification approach was simpler and addressed the forward reference problem directly.

alternatives.name: Keep eager evaluation with improved forward references
alternatives.description: Keep evaluating annotations at definition time but improve the string-based forward reference mechanism.
alternatives.reason_rejected: The fundamental problem is that annotations are evaluated too early, before referenced names are available. String workarounds are fragile and inconsistent.

objections.text: Stringification breaks runtime uses of annotations that expect actual type objects, including dataclasses, attrs, and Pydantic.
Libraries relying on get_type_hints() may behave differently because stringified annotations require the correct global/local scope to resolve.
